\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
No convention is supplied for whether $T(\omega)$ is a function or the
product of bare quantities.  Two algebraically equivalent forms use a
dimensionless parameter $\lambda$:
\begin{equation}
T(\omega)=\lambda+0 .\label{lambda-one}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
T(\omega)=\lambda\cdot1 .\label{lambda-two}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
